verdict.rationale: Productboard says it automatically detects insights in feedback and links them to related feature ideas, and that its built-in agent takes a new idea to delivery-ready by handling the synthesis. Its MCP server also lets external agents create features and subfeatures. Together these suggest AI can help turn feedback into structured work items, but no evidence shows a plain-language feedback description being turned into a proposed task breakdown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI generating a structured set of proposed tasks from a feedback description, details of the output structure and review/approval flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
